column1: # id <TAB> the one source line under test
# Every shape is assembled ALONE, in the preamble `sigil_today.sh` builds, with
# an accepted `move.w #$A101,d0` above it and `move.w #$A202,d0` below. Its own
# emitted word is therefore self-classifying on asl: `A101` means asl DECLINED
# to value the operand and substituted the last word it computed; anything else
# is an answer; nothing at all means the line emitted no code.
#   fu  function p,(p*7)+$100     body USES its parameter          fu(5)=$123
#   fi  function p,$3C7           body IGNORES its parameter       fi(5)=$3C7
#   f2  function p,q,(p*7)+q      two parameters                   f2(5,7)=$2A
#   dsp = $2A / dsp function p,(p*7)+$100   a name spelled BOTH ways
# The values share no digits with each other or with the $Annn carry setters, so
# no two readings of a line can produce the same word.
# ---- CONTROLS. Every one of these has an answer, and it is stated in the
# ---- expectation column of the note's table. A control that comes back as a
# ---- carry-over word means the harness itself is broken.
